bias.en: Rebound fading · gave back most of the Oct 28 gap
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 回吐 10月28日大部分跳空涨幅

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 7.9% on Oct 30 to $149.21, trading between $145.34 and $153.49 on 1.5 times average volume, with no 100-day yet (80 sessions). It is below the rising 5-day ($152.8) and falling 30-day ($166.5) averages and above the rising 10-day ($145.9). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, still below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($132.19), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月30日下跌 7.9%，收于 $149.21，盘中区间 $145.34–153.49，成交量为均量的 1.5 倍；上市仅 80 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于上行的 5 日（$152.8）和下行的 30 日均线（$166.5）下方，位于上行的 10 日均线（$145.9）上方。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$132.19），RSI 为 45。

read.en: After a 1.6% dip on Oct 29, the drop broke the $156.5–157.7 and $152.4 supports, now resistance, giving back most of the Oct 28 gap; $146.9–148.5 held. Resistance is $152.4–152.8 (Oct 14 high, 5-day), then $156.5–157.7 and $166.1–166.5 (Oct 28 high, 30-day). Support is $146.9–148.5, then $145.3–145.9 (Oct 30 low, 10-day) and $139.2–139.9. A close above $157.7 would target $166; below $145.3, $139–140.

bias.en: Rebound stalled · back under the 200-day, ₩1.38 million held
bias.zh: 反弹受阻 · 跌回 200 日均线下方，138 万韩元守住

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,418,000 in Seoul after a 7.1% drop on Oct 29 from ₩1,526,000 (₩1,381,000–1,449,000); the Oct 30 bar is flat. It is above the rising 10-day (₩1,348,200), below the rising 5-day (₩1,438,000) and 200-day (₩1,496,415), and below the falling 30-day (₩1,561,700) and 100-day (₩1,826,600). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 26 (₩1,234,437), and RSI is 46.

The Oct 28 close of ₩1,526,000 cleared the 200-day, but Oct 29 fell back below it; the ₩1,381,000–1,402,000 support held at the ₩1,381,000 low. Resistance is ₩1,438,000–1,449,000 (5-day, Oct 29 high), then ₩1,495,000–1,497,000 (200-day, Oct 27 and Oct 13 highs) and ₩1,558,000–1,587,000 (Sep 2 low, 30-day, Oct 28 high). Support is ₩1,381,000–1,402,000, then ₩1,348,200–1,358,000 (10-day, Oct 27 low) and ₩1,315,000. A close above ₩1,497,000 would target ₩1.56–1.59 million; below ₩1.38 million, ₩1.35 million.

s.en: Oct 26 high and Oct 29 low ₩1,381,000; Oct 13 low ₩1,402,000
